patterns.note: Alternating full-bleed dark and light sections, often with vibrant accent colors for backgrounds, creating distinct visual breaks.
Dramatic use of oversized, high-contrast serif typography for main headings and decorative elements, paired with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A dark base palette (black/dark grey) is contrasted with vibrant, almost neon accent colors (purple, green, yellow, pink) used for section backgrounds, CTAs, and animated text.

The hero section features a dynamic video or image slider that transitions on scroll, while subsequent content sections reveal with a fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport. The 'URBAN' text animates in letter by letter.
A repeating, decorative 'GET IN TOUCH' text pattern forms a unique visual footer element, reinforcing the brand's aesthetic.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed video or image slider with a dark overlay to ensure high contrast for overlaid, oversized serif text. This dynamic element transitions as the user scrolls or automatically.

A sticky header containing the logo, a 'CONTACT' button, and a hamburger menu remains fixed at the top of the viewport, while a scroll-to-top button appears and sticks to the bottom right after initial scrolling.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by GSAP, are used to reveal content sections. Elements within these sections (like images, text blocks, and the 'URBAN' heading) fade or slide into view with a staggered effect as the user scrolls them into the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, high-contrast serif display headings (up to ~5x body text) paired with clean, legible sans-serif for body and navigation, often in uppercase for labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp for most containers and images, with subtle rounding on buttons and interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced overall, with airy full-width hero and section headers, transitioning to a more compact grid for content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic interplay of oversized, high-contrast serif typography with vibrant, almost neon color accents against a predominantly dark background. The dynamic hero video/slider and the animated 'URBAN' text reveal create a sophisticated yet energetic feel, moving beyond a standard event venue template.
